prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict design preservation.
Asset: Mina dragon second-form illustration for the same anime game as the reference creatures.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the EXACT approved Mina dragon edit target, including corrected single matching wrist claws, frilled wing patterns and long tail with a large terminal blue gem.
Images 2, 3, 4 are rendering and COLOR-HARMONY references ONLY: Akari fox, Koharu deer, Rei bird. Use their shared clean polished anime sprite coloring, colored fine contours, soft controlled cel-shaded volumes and jewel highlights. Do NOT copy their species, anatomy, pattern, ornament, pose, or dominant character colors.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Repaint image 1 so its color treatment belongs to the SAME visual set as images 2-4. Keep Mina's identity: predominantly black and dark midnight navy, luminous blue eyes and sapphire/sky-blue gems, limited cool ivory-white trims. Compared with image 1, replace muddy neutral-gray shadows and overly heavy near-black outlines with clean deep blue-black shadows, clearer softly saturated navy midtones, restrained cool blue reflected light and finer dark colored contours. Make the overall rendering a little clearer and fresher, matching the references' gentle cel shading and selective soft highlights. Dark areas must still read as BLACK/NAVY, not bright blue, purple, gray or teal. Use the reference bird's clarity in dark feathers only as a rendering guide, not its purple/gold scheme. Bring the brooches and tail crystal into the same crisp delicate jewel rendering as the reference creatures. Preserve natural soft pale face coloring and Mina's quiet half-lidded feminine expression. No dramatic rim light, harsh black comic outlines, heavy grunge, realistic leathery surfaces, or new sparkle patterns.

LOCK THE APPROVED DESIGN EXACTLY:
Same wing-dominant scale, short compact sturdy body, same head and eye size, black fringe, two arms and two legs, same asymmetrical flying wingbeat pose, same complete silhouette and composition.
Keep ALL patterns exactly in their current positions and shapes: white scalloped maid-frill edging, thin pale-blue border lines, navy ribbons and bows, diamond wing ornaments, existing white body/tail accents. Do not expand the area of white. Do not invent new symbols, trim, scales or jewelry.
Each wing wrist has EXACTLY ONE matching ivory-tipped curved claw above its blue-gem bow. Keep the corrected anatomy from image 1; no second claw or horn.
Preserve the long flowing tail and the LARGE blue diamond which forms its final terminal tip, with no tail extending past the jewel. Same gem size and location.
Do not make the torso larger, shrink the wings, change proportions, add muscles, masculinize the face, or turn this into a quadruped.
Only the coloring, line color/weight and surface shading may change. No design changes.

OUTPUT:
ONE standalone Mina dragon, NOT a multi-pose sheet, no other characters. Same 3:2 landscape canvas and camera as image 1, fully visible wings and tail. True transparent-alpha background, with no smoke, halo, gradient, shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette, matching the clean cutout presentation of the other creatures. No text or labels.
